_about: Hand-authored classes, merged into the generated pack by tools/extract/build_documents.py (apply_manual_content). Put entries under "entries", keyed by name, with the item's system fields. A new name is added, tagged sourcebook "Custom" unless you give one. A name his data already builds is ignored unless the entry says "_override": true, in which case only the fields you give are laid over his. Keys starting with _ are notes and never read. Full guide: docs/ADDING-CONTENT.md. Rebuild with: python tools/extract/build_documents.py --write

_example._note: An example of the shape. Copy entries from here into "entries" to use them.

Waywarden.attackSkillList: Beginner at 1, Novice at 3, Intermediate at 6

_history: This file used to hold Elemental Dancer, hand-authored from his Word class template because his class dictionary had no row for it. His checkClassQualification holds that row inline, and his setClassSkillLists holds its skills, so it is now generated -- one document per element -- and the hand-authored entry was removed 2026-09-19. See DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-18, 'Every class's skills by title'.
